## Checklist

- [ ] Title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (English, imperative) — it becomes the squash commit
- [ ] `pnpm lint` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Checked on desktop and mobile
- [ ] Accessibility (RGAA): contrast, visible focus, keyboard, 200% zoom, 320px width
- [ ] New or changed translation keys reported in Xilofone
